message: Linking of Aadhaar and PAN is required to avoid the consequences of not linking PAN and Aadhaar in eligible cases, as per Circular 03/2023.
remediation: Link the Aadhaar with the PAN on the e-filing portal before the return is uploaded.

message: Quoting of Aadhaar in the ITR is required as per section 139AA in applicable cases, and linking of Aadhaar and PAN is required to avoid the consequences of not linking PAN and Aadhaar in eligible cases as per Circular 03/2023.
